title: The two fibre cycle classes of a coherent sheaf on a product with the projective line are rationally equivalent
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter chow.tex (Chow Homology and Chern Classes)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file chow.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma says that for a coherent sheaf F on X times P^1 whose support has dimension at most k + 1, with both fibres over zero and infinity of dimension at most k and with no embedded associated point of dimension at least k inside those fibres, the two fibre cycle classes are rationally equivalent on X (statement lines 3469-3487, tag 02S6). The proof reduces to a coefficient comparison and then does genuine local algebra: at the generic point of a component of the fibre it must use the absence of embedded associated points to conclude that the local module is Cohen-Macaulay, then use the dimension bound on the fibre to see that the coordinate cutting out the fibre is a nonzerodivisor, and finally match length_A(M/tM) with a sum over the minimal primes of the associated primes by an additivity statement. The local algebra is the substance, so the claim is H2.
